I have acne prone oily/combination skin so I would use my normal cleanser that never broke me out after so i wouldn't feel oily after using this product. But while using this I had such bad acne all over my cheeks and basically my whole face, borderline cystic acne. I never really get acne on my forehead but i had acne all on my forehead, my cheeks, my chin, even my nose literally everywhere which wasn't normal all the time for me, only when using products that dont go well with my skin. The acne only went down once I stopped using this and started using my normal products again. So if you're gonna get this be mindful that this is more like a lathering cleanser than a normal oil cleanser, if you have acne prone skin it might break you out, and the smell is very strong while using it. title: Contains known skin irritants. Sulfates.
date: Bewertet in den USA am20. Mai 2026
review: I’m an old school Aveda grad and skincare enthusiast. This product is marketed as “soap free” but it contains sulfates. If you have sensitive skin this product will eventually destroy your skin barrier and disrupt your microbiome.I tried to save money but ended up losing money. Sulfates are well known to produce skin irritation in a large percentage of the population. They are chemical degreasers. So while I find that my skin didn’t get dry and irritated the few times I use it, I would not use this daily on my skin. It simply well known to strip the skin of its natural oils and from there disrupt the Microbiome and with consistent use that’s exactly what would happen.I honestly didn’t think to check for sulfates because I just assumed a cleansing oil would not have that harsh ingredient. Even suave has products that have removed this ingredient. This is marketed for sensitive skin yet it contains ingredients known to cause problems with sensitive skin. It defeats the purpose of the product. I will stick with Bioderma despite it being more expensive.

This is super floral, artificial and ABUNDANT. I had to get back in the shower to wash it off as it clung to me in ways I can only describe as suffocating. I didn’t read the ingredients to see what fragrance was used prior to purchasing so my bad. But if you like strong, long lasting floral scents - you will fully enjoy this product. Again, everything else about it is 5 star.
